IPT.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/11] Pairwise analyses showed that parents' views of treatment credibility improved over time in CBT relative to SBFT (\chi^2=3.97; df=1; P=.05) and NST (\chi^2=13.08; df=1; P<.001).

Source.evidence_source:
[/page/5/Text/10] There were no differences among the groups in parent-or patient-rated treatment expectancies at intake, and no
[/page/5/Text/11] significant time or treatment×time effects. There was an overall group difference in the way parents' views of treatment credibility changed over time (treatment×time effect, \chi^2=12.90; df=2; P=.002).
